scope: Canonical logical data-model, normalized in-memory runtime, relationship-backed authorization simulation and canonical analytics lineage
requirements: Every inherited slash-combined family resolves to named atomic concepts with independent grain
Every atomic concept has at least 13 governance fields and three object-specific business fields
Relationships define source, field, target, cardinality, required status, delete behavior, ownership, temporal rule and invariant
Every concept exposes an explicit state vocabulary and transition contracts with guards, permissions, side effects, candidate communication, idempotency and recovery
Canonical application records contain identifiers and business facts; names, titles, stage labels and relative ages are projections
Every analytics row references a canonical application, source event and aggregate version
Row access uses organization, owner, assignment, role, purpose and effective-window relationships rather than deterministic sampling
Physical Salesforce targets and API names remain proposals until accountable approval and metadata implementation
